The **oracle ladder** (the owner's method, 2026-10-03): the vendor's PyTorch pipeline at the same request is the oracle of the MODEL; triton-sequential, the container's graph op by op, is the oracle of the CONTAINER (it matches the vendor: the trace is right); the Triton compiled mode is validated against both. A model that looks broken is never retraced on sight — the ladder first. A certified-only run at zero misses is itself the proof that no autotune cost is left at runtime. *no record* means none exists on this rack.

## Causes measured (docs/reference/model-status-notes.json)

- **`Allegro`** — A performance defect, named: the Triton flash-attention kernel runs at 0.18-0.20 TFLOP/s on the V100 at every head dim and length; Allegro's self-attention (B=2, H=24, T=14 080, D=96, fp16) takes 19.95 s through it against 0.131 s for the vendor's torch EFFICIENT_ATTENTION on the same card (152x); 99.6 % of a denoise step (NBX_TRITON_PROF, allegro_prof.log; allegro_sdpa_probe.py, flash_scan.py, 2026-10-03). Allegro is withheld from confirmation until the kernel is fixed.
- **`Allegro-TI2V`** — Census failed in both classes at the vendor's minimum 720x1280: no plan. 16 GB: the VAE's weights and overhead alone are 24 204 MB against a 12 296 MB budget, so no band count reaches it; 32 GB: the VAE's 475 200 MB of activations are not taken by the component tiling (logs_16g / logs_32g Allegro-TI2V.*.log, 2026-10-03). A Prism planning defect at the documented envelope.
- **`Ming-Lite-Omni-1.5`** — The derivation reproduces 0 of the walk's 27 keys (1 037 walked op pairs missed, 71 extra): a whole-model defect of the derivation, not of the model — not yet diagnosed.
- **`Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Thinking`** — The derivation misses 2 keys (a frozen view, named at 3afae124) and derives 16 extra; not yet classified.
- **`Sana_1600M_1024px_MultiLing`** — Census verdict 'retrace': 1 frozen symbol and 1 unadjudicated derived-relation break at the 1024 probe (census_16g.log, census_32g.log, 2026-10-03). The derivation misses 6 keys (18 pairs) at the walk's request. The oracle ladder decides before any retrace.
- **`Wan2.1-I2V-14B-480P-Diffusers`** — Two causes, two containers. The INSTALLED container (2026-06-15, before the 09-29 retrace, red-cells L15) has its 16 GB plan refused at the vendor's 480x832: vae_encoder 98 056 MB, no tile plan (explain-plan under the census door, 2026-10-03 21:2x, nbx/campaigns/2026_10_03_derivation/logs). The RETRACED build (private cache) runs out of memory at the transformer's SDPA::0 on 16 GB: 4.3 GB the driver reserves as local memory for sum_forward_kernel's whole-row tile (a 449 280-element row), outside every allocator — op-level probe +2 062 MB for one sum, +4 338 MB at CFG 2 (nbx/campaigns/2026_10_03_resume/lmem_probe.py, i2v_ledger2.jsonl); fixed on branch the-memory-ledger-samples-both-loops (sum/mean/amax walk the row in tiles), its rerun on card 1 pending. Not a Prism estimate gap.
- **`Wan2.1-VACE-1.3B-diffusers`** — The derivation misses 7 of the walk's 16 keys and derives 80 the walk did not form; the extras are not yet classified against the envelope.
- **`Wan2.2-I2V-A14B-Diffusers`** — The derivation misses 9 of the walk's 16 keys and derives 76 the walk did not form; the extras are not yet classified against the envelope.
- **`mochi-1-preview`** — Census probe at the container's tiling probe 480x848 failed: aten.mul::18 cannot broadcast (2, 22260, 24, 64) with (11872, 24, 120) — a rotary table carried at the trace's token count (11 872) instead of the request's (22 260). A trace-frozen dimension by its signature; the oracle ladder (vendor at 480x848, then triton-sequential) decides before any retrace (nbx/campaigns/2026_10_03_resume/logs_16g/mochi-1-preview.*probe*).
- **`openaudio-s1-mini`** — The derivation forms 2 413 keys where the walk formed 587 (1 826 extra); not yet classified against the envelope — no certification pass spends a card on them before it is.
